title: Two modes of teaching about the festivals
english: The perfect man is taught by God about the festal days; the inferior man is taught by the enlightened ones. There are two modes of teaching.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is introducing the section on the festal days, distinguishing two levels of instruction about the solemnities.

title: Prayer for the Law's Spiritual Unveiling
english: Since the law is spiritual, let us ask the Lord to open the shadows into truth. Our Passover is Christ.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is concluding his argument that the law is spiritual and now prays that God would open its shadows into truth, identifying Christ as the Christian Passover.

title: Lamp, bread, and oil as spiritual nourishment
english: The lamp and the loaves of the setting forth are the word that gives light and the food of life. The oil of sincerity.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the tabernacle furnishings spiritually, applying them to Christ and the soul.

title: Perpetual fire and remembrance before the Lord
english: A perpetual fire and a remembrance before the Lord (Leviticus 6:12-13). Do not extinguish the Spirit (1 Thessalonians 5:19). Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is concluding his homily on the lamp and the bread of the Presence, applying the perpetual fire of the sanctuary to the Spirit within the believer.
